rules.statement: CFG-BASE shall provide a full AXI4 Subordinate and an APB4 Manager with legal FIXED/INCR/WRAP bursts and ID echo.
CFG-BASE shall not include CDC, timeout, CSR, exclusive access, or USER/QOS/REGION features (disabled).
CFG-BASE shall use 32-bit AXI address/data and 32-bit APB address/data, default ID width 4, and a shared clock.
The AXI ID width may be configured at elaboration.
